title: Tiamat
wikitext:
I study at MGATHT. Moscow State Academy of Fine Chemical Technology. I'm in my 4th year.

I like beautiful girls (and who doesn't? ;)), beautiful cars, much less Quake, and of course alcohol ;)) (mostly beer), chatting with friends, my favorite music is Doom Metal, but I don't get hung up on it. I really like strategy games. I also like to play pool with friends. I really like the latest WaReZzz.

My character... how can I say it... can be tough at times... well, I don't know. Anyway, let my friends talk. I'm generally modest, sociable, cheerful (listed in descending order).
